title: Introducing SIT Nexus™ — Integrated Territory & Activation Programs
content:
Two Programs. One IntegratedStrategy.

Since launching SIT GroundForce™and SIT Engage™, one question has consistently come from clients who understoodboth programs: can we run them together?

The answer has always been yes.For clients who have combined structured territory outreach with brandactivation programs, the results have consistently outperformed either programrunning independently. The neighborhood familiarity built through GroundForce™territory presence amplifies the impact of Engage™ activation events. The brandimpressions created through Engage™ activations give GroundForce™ outreach aricher context to build on.

Today we are formalizing thatcombination as a named program: SIT Nexus™ — Integrated Territory &Activation Programs.

### What SIT Nexus™ Is

SIT Nexus™ is the integration point between SIT GroundForce™ and SIT Engage™ — combining structured neighborhood territory outreach with professional brand activation into one cohesive market strategy.

The name reflects the function: a nexus is a connection point, a place where separate elements come together into something more powerful than either alone. SIT Nexus™ is where territory presence meets brand activation — and where the compound effect of both running together in the same markets produces the kind of market coverage that changes a brand's position in a community.

### Who SIT Nexus™ Is Built For

Contractor and service brands that want both structured neighborhood outreach and event-based community presence in their territory. Consumer brands that want consistent homeowner familiarity combined with high-impact activation moments. Companies entering new Midwest suburban markets who want full-territory coverage from day one rather than building each channel separately.

SIT Nexus™ is not a requirement. SIT GroundForce™ and SIT Engage™ remain strong independent programs. But for clients who want the most comprehensive territory strategy available — Nexus is the integrated answer.

### The Tagline That Defines It

Where Territory Meets Activation.  SIT GroundForce™ builds the foundation— consistent, structured, neighborhood-level recognition over time. SIT Engage™ creates the activation moments — high-impact brand interactions that convert familiarity into consideration. Together under SIT Nexus™, they create a market presence that compounds in both directions simultaneously.

### WhatComes Next

SIT Nexus™ program consultationsare now open. Request an overview to discuss how the integrated GroundForce™and Engage™ approach applies to your specific market, trade category, or brandobjectives in the Chicago–Milwaukee corridor and expanding Wisconsin markets.
